title: Orbital Overlap: Bonding Theories — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Bonding theories practice for CHEM 1A (default) and CHEM 1B review (add ?course=1B), OpenStax Chemistry 2e Chapter 8. Four tiles students can mix: Overlap Basics (what makes a bond, the H2 energy curve with tap-the-curve questions, an Overlap Gallery of s–s, s–p and p–p overlap, which orbitals overlap in H2, HF, HCl, F2 and Cl2, and why bond strengths differ using OpenStax Table 8.1), Hybrid Workshop (why hybridize, the groups → hybrid table, hybridize the central atom from a Lewis structure, flat Lewis → real bond angle with wedge-and-dash sketches, orbital-box promotion builder, tag every atom in multi-center molecules, and sp3d/sp3d2 expanded octets), Sigma & Pi (count σ and π bonds in full and line drawings, a Bond Labeler for every bond, boss molecules caffeine and aspirin, where π bonds come from, restricted rotation, resonance and delocalized π), and MO Builder (LCAO pictures, which energy ordering, a tap-to-fill MO diagram builder for 23 homonuclear diatomics and ions, reading bond order and magnetism, bond order trends, HOMO and ionization). Learn mode shows Professor Tips and step-by-step worked examples; Practice gives mistake-specific feedback on every wrong choice; Challenge is 10 mixed questions with no hints and a study plan. Bond orders, electron counts and magnetism are computed from the MO filling. XP, ranks, 12 achievements and matched ItsDrDan videos. Also: a Hybrid Mixer (tap s, p and d cards into hybrids), a bond-order Ranker, a Theory Face-Off boss round (O2 and the magnet: VB vs MO), Skill Check Prep with typed answers, and a Daily 5 that shares the ItsDrDan day streak. Add ?mode=daily, ?mode=skill or ?mode=challenge to open those directly.
